newsitem.title: USA: U.S. tech shares rise on rating upgrades, outlook.
newsitem.headline: U.S. tech shares rise on rating upgrades, outlook.

text.p: Stocks of semiconductor companies, computer disk drive makers and networking firms rose in midmorning trading after several closely watched analysts raised their ratings on key stocks.
Disk makers Quantum Corp and Western Digital Corp were upgraded at Smith Barney, while electronics maker Analog Devices Inc was raised to "buy" at UBS Securities.
Investors were taking advantage of recent lows to buy shares of the stronger technology companies, analysts said.
"Tech stocks have been down substantially in the last few weeks and I think excessively so," said Larry Aashiem, a money manager at Corestates Investment Advisors.
Shares of Fore Systems Inc, a networking company, were up 1-1/8 at 24-3/8 and were the most active issue on Nasdaq.
Advanced Micro Devices Inc shares extended gains for a second day, rising 2-5/8 to 48. Micron Technology Inc, another semiconductor stock, rose 7/8 to 42-1/4, and Analog Devices gained 7/8 to 24.
Quantum led the rise in disk drive stocks, up 7/8 at 40-3/8. Western Digital was up 1-1/4 at 65-3/4.
